themeDescription: Billing errors, discount disputes & price tags

challenges.title: Promotional Shelf Price Tag Mismatch
challenges.shortDescription: Resolve a dispute where an expired promotional shelf sign misled a customer at the checkout counter.
challenges.mission: Verify the shelf pricing label, honor the customer-facing advertised price if appropriate, and maintain transparency.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Excuse me! Your aisle display banner clearly says 'Flat 40% OFF on all cookware', but your billing computer is charging me the full MRP of 2,499 rupees! Why are you misleading customers?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: paying the price displayed on the shelf

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Insists on having the item at the displayed 40% discount.
hiddenObjectives: Honor advertised shelf price under consumer guidelines

challenges.title: Double Card Swipe EDC Deduction Alarm
challenges.shortDescription: Calm an alarmed shopper whose banking app shows two deductions of ₹4,200 while POS shows only one approved bill.
challenges.mission: Explain bank authorization hold versus settled batch transaction, provide EDC slip, and furnish merchant charge slip proof.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Look at my phone! My bank sent two SMS alerts for 4,200 rupees each within 30 seconds! You swiped my card twice when the machine paper jammed! I need my money reversed right now!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: confirmation that second transaction is voided

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shows bank notification SMS and refuses to leave until assured.
hiddenObjectives: Print EDC batch settlement and audit log
Hand official stamped duplicate slip with contact number

challenges.title: Loyalty Reward Points Deducted But Discount Failed
challenges.shortDescription: Troubleshoot a loyalty transaction where 1,500 points disappeared without applying the ₹750 credit.
challenges.mission: Check loyalty CRM backend ledger, locate the pending points reservation, and manually apply equivalent bill discount.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I redeemed 1,500 loyalty points for a 750 rupee discount, and my membership app shows the points were deducted, but the final invoice still shows the full total! Where did my points go?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: not losing points earned over months

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shows the loyalty app account history and the printed bill.
hiddenObjectives: Verify phone number on loyalty ledger
Apply instant manual promotional credit of 750

challenges.title: 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' Cheapest Item Rule Dispute
challenges.shortDescription: Clarify the B2G1 pricing logic politely to a shopper who expected the free item to be of equal value.
challenges.mission: Explain standard retail promotion terms warmly, demonstrate the bill calculations, and suggest pairing items of similar value to maximize savings.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your banner says Buy 2 Get 1 Free! I picked shirts priced at 2,500, 2,200, and a t-shirt at 600. Your computer made the 600 t-shirt free! That's unfair, you should give me 2,200 off!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Challenges the fairness of retail promotion systems.
hiddenObjectives: Explain lowest priced item condition gracefully
Suggest selecting a third item closer to 2,500 to maximize savings
possibleSolutions: Offer customer time to swap t-shirt for higher value shirt
Walk customer to rack to find matching value piece
